text.tspan: Why Bottom-Up is O(n): Most nodes reside near bottom leaves (heights 0 and 1).
Fewer comparisons are needed near leaves; total sum converges to O(n), not O(n log n).

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Bottom-up heapify builds a valid max-heap in linear O(n) time before sorting begins.
